item.title: A Universal Spin‐Polarization‐Engineered Antibonding‐Orbital Modulation Paradigm for Accelerating Reaction Kinetics in Ultrahigh‐Rate Sodium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a universal spin-polarization-engineered antibonding-orbital modulation paradigm to weaken robust M─S bonds, overcoming intrinsic kinetic barriers in conversion anodes. Magnetic Mn doping induces a low-to-high spin transition, boosting antibonding electron occupancy. The resulting Mn-FeS₂/CoS₂ anode achieves 300 mAh g⁻¹ at 120 A g⁻¹ and 13,000-cycle stability, validating a general strategy for ultrahigh-rate sodium-ion batteries.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · conversion anode · spin polarization · antibonding orbital · ultrahigh rate
